A006.features: After tall looped body, short upper stroke and dark lower bowl; top may be hooked or barred.

A007.features: Short dark form contiguous with preceding crossed stem; low bowl or additional crossed stem may be present.

A008.features: Tall left-bowl body adjacent to barred left-bowl body; upper cross-stroke association uncertain.

A005.features: Oblique narrow low stroke adjacent to preceding looped body, possibly footed stem or trough.

U001.features: Tall tangled initial group at line 5 group 9; looped ascender and broad lower flourish, probable one or two cipher bodies.

spacing_and_joining.note: Minimal spatial gap; could be one connected word. Kept as visible groups.
Initial tall body followed closely by low multihump string; boundary not secure.
Initial cluster unsegmented; one-mask encoding has body-count interval [1,2].

features: Leading two Arabic-like forms read graphically as 1 then angular 4, followed by point.
Month component has long oblique left stroke, upper horizontal roof, lower crossbar, and two right descending/upward strokes.
Right month strokes appear to converge low and rise right, favoring a V-like joined pair, but touching strokes and ruling make II alternative viable.
Then point and four digit-like bodies with contours 1,9,0,3, followed by point.
date.month_confidence: uncertain; IV favored only by apparent lower convergence, no calendar context
